name: 16335 · Meadville, PA
findings: ZIP 16335 (Meadville) has 173 nonprofit organizations. 80 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 69 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16335 (Meadville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 16335 (Meadville) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
